page0.text:
...Hm.
If I'm being honest, it's hard to deal with her.
Still, I know that Rider is on our side.
Rider being here isn't what bothers me. Rather...

page1.text:
"Aren't you going to eat, Rider? Sakura and I are eating, so it's awkward if you just sit there."
...I feel uncomfortable that Rider is the only one not eating.

page2.text:
"I am not eating."
Oh. She's kinda upset.
"Why not? Servants get hungry, too. Saber didn't say so, but she ate a lot."

page3.text: "She is different from the rest of us. I have no interest in human nutrition, and to begin with...your way of eating is not suited to me."

page4.text:
"Oh. If you can't use chopsticks, you should have just said so."
"Huh? Senpai?"
"Hang on. I'm going to get Rider a spoon and some plates."

page5.text:
"That's right, I'll make an omelette, too. It'll just take a moment."
"Sakura."

page6.text:
"It's okay, Rider. This is our first meal together, you know. If you're going to be taking care of me, then it's the least we can do."
Sakura comes to the kitchen cheerfully.

page7.text:
"Should we make her soup while we're at it? We have extra consommé."
"Oh, that's a good idea. There are tomatoes too, so let's get it done in a jiffy!"
